content:
SUBDIRS = unicode-conformance

TESTS_ENVIRONMENT = \
        srcdir=${srcdir}; export srcdir; \
        top_builddir=${top_builddir}; export top_builddir; \
        EXEEXT=${EXEEXT}; export EXEEXT;

AM_TESTS_ENVIRONMENT = $(TESTS_ENVIRONMENT)

TESTS = run.tests

check_SCRIPTS = run.tests

TEST_DATAS = \
        test_CapRTL_explicit.input \
        test_CapRTL_explicit.reference \
        test_CapRTL_implicit.input \
        test_CapRTL_implicit.reference \
        test_CapRTL_isolate.input \
        test_CapRTL_isolate.reference \
        test_ISO8859-8_hebrew.input \
        test_ISO8859-8_hebrew.reference \
        test_UTF-8_persian.input \
        test_UTF-8_persian.reference \
        test_UTF-8_reordernsm.input \
        test_UTF-8_reordernsm.reference


EXTRA_DIST = \
        $(TESTS) \
        $(TEST_DATAS)

SUFFIXES: .reference .input

.reference.input:
        testcase="$@" && \
        charset="`echo "$@" | sed 's/_[^_]*$$//;s/.*_//'`" && \
        $(top_builddir)/bin/fribidi --test --charset "$$charset" "$<" > "$@" \
        || ($(RM) "$@"; false)

references:
        for testcase in "$(srcdir)"/test_*.input; do \
                test="`echo $$testcase \
                  | sed 's/\.input$$/.reference/i; s|.*/||;'`" && \
                $(MAKE) $(AM_MAKEFLAGS) "$(srcdir)/$$test" || \
                exit 1; \
        done


-include $(top_srcdir)/git.mk
---
tests = [
  ['CapRTL', 'explicit'],
  ['CapRTL', 'implicit'],
  ['CapRTL', 'isolate'],
  ['ISO8859-8', 'hebrew'],
  ['UTF-8', 'persian'],
  ['UTF-8', 'reordernsm'],
]

test_runner = find_program('test-runner.py')

foreach t : tests
  charset = t[0]
  suffix = t[1]
  test_name = '@0@_@1@'.format(charset, suffix)
  input_file = files('test_@0@.input'.format(test_name))
  reference_file = files('test_@0@.reference'.format(test_name))
  test(test_name, test_runner, args: [fribidi, charset, input_file, reference_file])
endforeach

if get_option('fuzzer_ldflags') != ''
  cases = run_command(import('python3').find_python(), '-c',
    '''import os; print('\n'.join(os.listdir('@0@')))'''.format(join_paths(meson.current_source_dir(), 'fuzzing'))
  ).stdout().strip().split('\n')
  foreach case : cases
    test('@0@'.format(case), fribidi_fuzzer, args: [join_paths(meson.current_source_dir(), 'fuzzing', case)])
  endforeach
endif

subdir('unicode-conformance')
---
Makefile.am
fuzzing
meson.build
run.tests
test-runner.py
test_CapRTL_explicit.input
test_CapRTL_explicit.reference
test_CapRTL_implicit.input
test_CapRTL_implicit.reference
test_CapRTL_isolate.input
test_CapRTL_isolate.reference
test_ISO8859-8_hebrew.input
test_ISO8859-8_hebrew.reference
test_UTF-8_persian.input
test_UTF-8_persian.reference
test_UTF-8_reordernsm.input
test_UTF-8_reordernsm.reference
unicode-conformance
